 24/7 Live Raleigh Durham Fayetteville Surrounding Area COMMUNITY & EVENTS 
 Tree lighting in Downtown Raleigh kicks off NC Christmas holiday season 
 Saturday, November 21, 2026 1:40AM 
 Watch Eyewitness News, First Alert Weather, and original programming. RALEIGH, N.C. (WTVD) -- The 2026 holiday season in Raleigh is officially here!
 The city's tree-lighting celebration takes place Friday from 5:30 to 8 p.m. at Moore Square, 300 S. Blount St.
 The tree lighting is scheduled to happen between 6:15 p.m. and 6:30 p.m.
 The 2026 holiday season in Raleigh is officially here! The tree lighting is scheduled to happen between 6:15 p.m. and 6:30 p.m. at Moore Square, 300 S. Blount St. 
 According to the Downtown Raleigh Alliance , the family fun event will again feature entertainment, activities for kids, and photos with Santa. Kids can also get a jump on writing their letter to Santa and send it off to the North Pole!
 List of Kids' Activities
 Photos with Santa: Capture a free festive photo with Santa Claus, courtesy of Raleigh Magazine.
 Letters to Santa: Kids can write their letters and send them off to the North Pole.
 Ornament Making Station: Make your own custom ornament to take home.
 Fairy Hair: Get sparkly strands from Izella's Fairy Hair.
 Meet and snap a photo with NC Courage mascot Roary.
 Marbles Kids Museum: Join the Marbles team for hands-on, playful holiday fun
 Downtown restaurants and shops will also be open for visitors looking to get an early start on their Christmas shopping.
 The holiday season kicks off with the Moore Square tree lighting on Friday and continuing with the ABC11 Crossroads Ford Raleigh Christmas Parade presented by Shop Local Raleigh on Saturday. 
 The tree lighting serves as a prelude to the highly anticipated Raleigh Christmas Parade , which follows on Saturday.
 Raleigh Christmas Parade
 The parade is celebrating its 82nd year in 2026 . The Grand Marshal this year is NC State Chancellor Kevin Howell .
 ABC11 will provide live coverage starting at 9:00 a.m., with the parade beginning at 9:30 a.m.

 The beloved holiday tradition returns Saturday, Nov. 21, with festivities beginning at 9:30 a.m. So grab your most festive fit, bring plenty of holiday cheer, and get ready to celebrate in downtown Raleigh! 
 For those unable to attend in person, ABC11 will livestream the entire event, ensuring you don't miss a moment. 
 For our full guide, see here . 
 Parade Route 
 The parade will follow this route:
 Starts at the intersection of Hillsborough Street and St. Mary's Street
 Proceeds east on Hillsborough Street to the State Capitol
 Turns right onto Salisbury Street
 Turns left onto Morgan Street
 Turns right onto Fayetteville Street
 Ends at Lenoir Street, where it disbands

 Here's a list of the City of Raleigh's free parking decks for the parade.
